Class JMSConnectionPool

java.lang.Object
io.micronaut.jms.pool.AbstractPool<PooledObject<jakarta.jms.Connection>>
io.micronaut.jms.pool.JMSConnectionPool
All Implemented Interfaces:
jakarta.jms.ConnectionFactory
public class JMSConnectionPool extends AbstractPool<PooledObject<jakarta.jms.Connection>> implements jakarta.jms.ConnectionFactory
Decorator of the provided ConnectionFactory to ensure maximum reuse of Connection instances.
